item.title: Linear
item.description: Linear MCP is Linear’s own hosted server, reachable at mcp.linear.app, that lets an agent create, update, and search issues, projects, and cycles in natural language instead of through the UI. It authenticates via OAuth on first connection rather than a static API token.
